attachments.name: Virtual and Augmented Reality: New Frontiers for Clinical Psychology
attachments.description: In the last decades, the applied approach for the use of virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) on clinical and health psychology has grown exponentially. These technologies have been used to treat several mental disorders, for example, phobias, stress-related disorders, depression, eating disorders, and chronic pain.
